sloka: असेव्यः सततम् चैव निस्तृण द्रुम पल्लवः ।इमाम् वा सरितम् च अद्य शोषयिष्यामि लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-३४॥
transliteration: asevyaḥ satatam caiva nistṛṇa druma pallavaḥ ।imām vā saritam ca adya śoṣayiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-34॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana if this river does not tell me about that noble Sita with countenance like the moon, I will drain it dry right now.
